_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — not applied automatically. Apply manually to a test bucket first (see README, Garage test checklist). Garage lifecycle support is partial and version-dependent: verify on your exact Garage build that Expiration and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload behave as expected before applying to a production bucket. 90 days is the longest TTL the human frontend offers, so this rule is a backstop only: pastes with shorter TTLs are already unreadable via the API once their expires-at passes, long before this sweeper deletes them. Do not set this below the longest TTL you actually use, or the sweeper could delete objects the API still considers live. Deletion is day-rounded and asynchronous.
